Hi Aria — thanks for the note and sorry to hear about the staging hiccup. We can usually support one-off pilot boosts for PLG signups on a case-by-case basis.

A couple quick questions to help us size the voucher:
- Expected peak concurrency and longest sequence length (tokens) for your production sim?
- Intended primary workload (generation for docs, chat, embeddings, rerank)?
- Is the pilot gated to a small team (<=10 users) or company-wide?

If you can send a screenshot of the current usage window (or a link to the Drive report) and confirm procurement's preferred wording, I will loop in RevOps to approve and generate a code.

Cc'ing Ben (sales lead) and Marissa (RevOps) to expedite.

— Jasmine
